name: WebGUI
principles: minimal DOM construction and structural rendering
no dependency on DWH, IAM, AccessCore or WebEngine semantics
one public JavaScript entry point exists at the repository root
themes are selected by instance configuration
WebGUI owns generic presentation semantics under .wg-* while Style owns visual implementation
mustNot: depend on WebEngine or another host framework
own page composition or projector lifecycle
encode visual appearance into .wg-* semantic class names
